name: Content-Topology-First Second-Family Divergence
decision_basis: Director instructed Design Sol to continue after Audit 11 recommended the first lawful path.
purpose: Seek one genuinely distinct second visual family under the unchanged Phase-B two-family prerequisite while directly addressing VFD-01 transfer collapse by freezing materially disjoint content/cause topologies before any new representation premise exists.
program_identity: CTF-01 is an explicitly new successor program, not VFD-01 continuation, VFD-02 automation, P4 rescue, or reuse of the VFD image budget.
All VFD-01 P1-P4 premise laws, renderer packets, and images remain diagnostic/control evidence only and may not seed candidate representation premises.
The current provisional C0/O3/TYP/MAT/STA/MOT family remains later comparison control only and may not seed candidate construction.
required_pre_exposure_freeze: a finite set of materially disjoint neutral content/cause topology classes and a deterministic pairwise orthogonality test
a fresh set of representation-premise slots constructed only after topology classes are frozen
a cross-product assignment law preventing one representation premise from inheriting a topology-specific motif as its identity
contamination quarantine covering VFD-01 and the current provisional family
family-survival, anti-copy, accessibility, no-reroll, and termination consequences
hard_boundaries: No candidate topology, visual premise, renderer packet, or image exists at authorization time.
No VFD-01 premise may be repaired, renamed, restyled, or reused as a CTF-01 candidate.
No P4 promotion, second transfer, or mosaic-seeded premise.
No CLR-01 reentry, hero/static reopening, current-family refinement, CMP-03, product semantics, functional iconography, implementation, final identity, or Phase-C convergence.
next_action: Freeze and recursively audit the CTF-01 pre-exposure method on promoted main. Only after the method is clean may one serial CTF-01 branch open from that exact checkpoint.
audit_result: DIRECTOR PATH AUTHORIZATION RECORDED; METHOD NOT YET FROZEN.
